Aalto|Abby.ctx: Aalto notes Abby can absorb Threnodian frequencies and act as a temporary host.

Aalto|Aemeath.ctx: Aemeath pitches Aalto for Black Shores funding for the Exostrider Project.

Aalto|Baizhi.ctx: Aalto doubts Baizhi, who trusts her own research, will ever buy his intel.

Aalto|Buling.ctx: Buling feels Aalto is an old friend who knows even more people than she does.

Aalto|Calcharo.ctx: Calcharo's Ghost Hounds do clean business with Aalto, and Calcharo refers clients to him.

Aalto|Camellya.ctx: Camellya respects Aalto's mind games but finds him too reliant on trickery to be a worthy opponent.

Aalto|Cartethyia.ctx: Aalto cross-checks Cartethyia's frequency samples at the Black Shores.

Aalto|Chixia.ctx: Chixia once tried to arrest Aalto in Jinzhou, taking him for a criminal.

Aalto|Cosmos.ctx: Cosmos and Cloudy dash off with Encore while Aalto is mid-sentence.

Aalto|Encore.ctx: Black Shores consultants who work missions as a duo; Aalto looks after Encore.

Aalto|Galbrena.ctx: Galbrena sends Tacet Discord data back to the Black Shores; Aalto is the one who receives it.

Aalto|Jiyan.ctx: Aalto admires Jiyan's generalship; Jiyan appreciates the strategic use of fog.

Aalto|Lucilla.ctx: Aalto represents the Black Shores to Lucilla on the Synchronist Program's future.

Aalto|Lynae.ctx: Lynae knows Aalto's reputation for handling intel in New Federation circles.

Aalto|Mornye.ctx: Aalto sits in on Professor Mornye's lecture.

Aalto|Mortefi.ctx: Aalto has heard of Mortefi's way with difficult clients.

Aalto|Rover.ctx: Aalto helps Rover through Dark Tides and Lahai-Roi; Rover thanks him for everything.

Aalto|Shorekeeper.ctx: The Shorekeeper values Aalto as the Black Shores' negotiator.

Aalto|Sigrika.ctx: Sigrika works out that Aalto is the sponsor behind the Academy project.

Aalto|Taoqi.ctx: Taoqi explains Jinzhou's Retroact Rain defences while Aalto tracks the outbreak's cause.

Aalto|Valentina.ctx: Valentina relays Tethys warnings built on data Aalto provided.

Aalto|Verina.ctx: Verina once offered Aalto a Starflower for news of her mother.

Aalto|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Xiangli Yao turned down Aalto's offer to join the Black Shores.

Aalto|Yangyang.ctx: Aalto, an information broker, admires how Yangyang reads the "Streams".

Aalto|Youhu.ctx: Aalto takes Youhu's broken-up call at the Black Shores.

Abby|Aemeath.ctx: Abby tries to stop Aemeath's frequency from leaking.

Abby|Augusta.ctx: Abby can hardly believe the Augusta of the stories is the Ephor in the arena.

Abby|Brant.ctx: Brant welcomed Rover and Abby aboard his ship as guests of honour.

Abby|Camellya.ctx: Camellya cuts Abby's photo time short.

Abby|Cantarella.ctx: Cantarella senses the Dark Tide's frequency in Abby.

Abby|Carlotta.ctx: Abby credits Carlotta's quick thinking against the sneaky Priest.

Abby|Cartethyia.ctx: Abby tracks Cartethyia's frequency with Rover in Ragunna.

Abby|Changli.ctx: Abby wonders why people are so divided about Changli.

Abby|Chisa.ctx: Chisa welcomes Abby aboard in Honami.

Abby|Chixia.ctx: Chixia makes sure Abby isn't left out of Jinzhou's gatherings.

Abby|Ciaccona.ctx: Abby and Ciaccona share hopes for Ragunna's rebuilding.

Abby|Cosmos.ctx: Cosmos runs dream-link stability tests that Abby wanders into.

Abby|Cristoforo.ctx: Cristoforo suggests Abby might recall its "true self" if it merged with Leviathan.

Abby|Denia.ctx: Abby wonders if they will ever see Denia again.

Abby|Fenrico.ctx: Fenrico greets Rover and Abby as the Righteous One's party.

Abby|Fulmine.ctx: Abby is too sleepy to help Fulmine with the Plushies.

Abby|Galbrena.ctx: Galbrena and Rover use Abby's power against the Threnodian; Abby helps find her.

Abby|Hsin.ctx: Abby recognises Hsin the Moon Fox's frequency.

Abby|Iuno.ctx: Abby still remembers Iuno when the rest of the world forgets her.

Abby|Jianxin.ctx: Abby is shocked to see Jianxin hurt.

Abby|Jinhsi.ctx: Jinhsi learns the Sonoro Sphere was the work of Abbowser, Abby's darker side.

Abby|Jué.ctx: Jué suggested Abby might be an entity like itself.

Abby|Lenore.ctx: Abby wonders whether the Sentinel cares about Lenore's small worries.

Abby|Lucilla.ctx: Lucilla calls Rover and Abby in about "the one from afar".

Abby|Lucy.ctx: Abby explains Tacet Marks to Lucy.

Abby|Lupa.ctx: Abby remembers Lupa's warning about the Blightcloud over the Sanguis Plateaus.

Abby|Lynae.ctx: Abby and Lynae deal with the Voidworm together in the Frostlands.

Abby|Margherita.ctx: Abby can't wait to eat at Margherita's.

Abby|Mornye.ctx: Abby thinks Professor Mornye is "a real gem".

Abby|Namipon.ctx: Abby distrusted Namipon's smell, then liked its snacks.

Abby|Phoebe.ctx: Phoebe is curious how Rover met Abby; Abby is glad to see her.

Abby|Phrolova.ctx: Abby wonders why Phrolova studied what she did.

Abby|Qingxiao.ctx: Qingxiao promises to remember Abby's name.

Abby|Rebecca.ctx: Rebecca wishes she had an Echo buddy like Abby.

Abby|Roccia.ctx: Roccia guesses Abby saved Rover and retreated into their body to rest.

Abby|Rover.ctx: Abby, who answers to the name Abraxas, lives within Rover and travels with them.

Abby|Sanhua.ctx: Abby is relieved to spot Sanhua in a strange place.

Abby|Shorekeeper.ctx: The Shorekeeper looks for a way to fix Abby's weakening frequency.

Abby|Sigrika.ctx: Sigrika laughs at Abby sounding like a Soliskin.

Abby|Suisui.ctx: Suisui feeds Abby her Ultimate Flavor Under Heaven.

Abby|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Abby senses Xiangli Yao's childhood memories in a Sonoro.

Abby|Xinyi.ctx: Xinyi welcomes Rover and Abby back to Hongzhen.

Abby|Xuanqing.ctx: Abby sniffs out Xuanqing's Feeling Capsule pieces.

Abby|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang studied Abby as an Echo and sends them snacks from Jinzhou.

Abby|Zani.ctx: Abby looks forward to seeing Zani and Phoebe again.

Aemeath|Camellya.ctx: Aemeath wants another round with Camellya.

Aemeath|Chisa.ctx: Aemeath and Chisa part with the promise of a new beginning together.

Aemeath|Denia.ctx: Denia recognises Aemeath as the Academy's legendary "Fleet Snowfluff".

Aemeath|Hiyuki.ctx: Hiyuki was away when Aemeath vanished in the simulator and reads her report closely.

Aemeath|Lucilla.ctx: Lucilla admires Aemeath's steel and works to bring her back.

Aemeath|Luuk Herssen.ctx: Luuk sees Aemeath's stubborn courage and helps bring her back through the Exostrider.

Aemeath|Mornye.ctx: Mornye studies the signal that might come from Aemeath; Aemeath cheers Rover for saving Mornye.

Aemeath|Rover.ctx: Aemeath was raised by Rover's former self; in Lahai-Roi they stand before the Exostrider together.

Aemeath|Shorekeeper.ctx: The Shorekeeper backs Dr. Luuk's proposal to bring Aemeath back.

Aemeath|Sigrika.ctx: Sigrika loves Fleet Snowfluff's songs and missed her last fan meeting.

Alannah|Yuanwu.ctx: Alannah knows Yuanwu secretly owns the Liuxian Teahouse.

Augusta|Avidius.ctx: Avidius challenged Augusta for Septimont with the Senate's favour; she respected him as an opponent.

Augusta|Brant.ctx: Augusta and Brant regroup with Rover against the Dark Tide.

Augusta|Buling.ctx: Augusta was taken with Buling from their first meeting and grateful for her help.

Augusta|Cantarella.ctx: Augusta relies on the Fisalia family's potions against the Dark Tide.

Augusta|Carlotta.ctx: Augusta and Carlotta hold the line together against the Dark Tide.

Augusta|Cartethyia.ctx: Augusta learned from the Dark Tide that Cartethyia planned her own "death".

Augusta|Cristoforo.ctx: Cristoforo meant Augusta to be Leviathan's Harbinger.

Augusta|Galbrena.ctx: Augusta and Galbrena (once Angel) grew up together in Fabianum before their homeland fell.

Augusta|Iuno.ctx: Septimont's Ephor and its prodigy priestess, friends since Iuno "prophesied" Augusta would lead a new era.

Augusta|Lupa.ctx: Augusta sees Lupa as a born arena genius; Lupa wonders why the Ephor fought.

Augusta|Phoebe.ctx: Augusta and Phoebe entered the Dark Tide together, protected by its Echoes.

Augusta|Qiuyuan.ctx: Augusta asks after the Huanglong swordsman Qiuyuan.

Augusta|Rover.ctx: Rover sees Augusta as the prophesied Hero of Heroes; they defeated the Sovereign together.

Avidius|Carlotta.ctx: Carlotta warns Avidius about the enemy's abnormal abilities.

Avidius|Cristoforo.ctx: Avidius was one of Cristoforo's creations, planted as a decoy.

Avidius|Galbrena.ctx: Galbrena discovered that Avidius was Cristoforo's long-planted decoy in Septimont.

Avidius|Iuno.ctx: Iuno felt something unnatural about Avidius, yet honours how he roared at fate.

Avidius|Rover.ctx: Avidius, a Quillbearer creation, fought for a story of hope; in the altered Septimont he blames Rover.

Avidius|Zani.ctx: Avidius helped Zani evacuate Egla Town.

Baizhi|Chixia.ctx: Jinzhou friends with opposite temperaments who grew to understand each other.

Baizhi|Jinhsi.ctx: Jinhsi sends Rover to Baizhi at Huaxu Academy.

Baizhi|Jiyan.ctx: Jiyan respects Baizhi as one of the few who have found their calling.

Baizhi|Lingyang.ctx: Lingyang once thought Baizhi's You'tan was his kind.

Baizhi|Lumi.ctx: Lumi hauls Baizhi's heavy research parcels.

Baizhi|Mortefi.ctx: Huaxu Academy colleagues in different departments who cooperate smoothly.

Baizhi|Rover.ctx: Baizhi, the Huaxu researcher, was among Rover's first friends in Jinzhou and analyses clues for them.

Baizhi|Sanhua.ctx: Sanhua worked with Baizhi on a project for the Magistrate.

Baizhi|Verina.ctx: Verina notes that "Baizhi" is an old name for angelica, a flower that blooms in the cold.

Baizhi|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Huaxu Academy researchers who admire each other's work.

Baizhi|Yangyang.ctx: Jinzhou friends; Baizhi values how well Yangyang listens, Yangyang how Baizhi helps.

Baizhi|Yuanwu.ctx: Baizhi finds Yuanwu's tea sweeter than any teahouse's.

Baizhi|Zhezhi.ctx: Zhezhi visits Chixia and tells Baizhi about Rover.

Brant|Calcharo.ctx: In a comedy event Calcharo's Ghost Hounds capture Brant for a bounty.

Brant|Carlotta.ctx: The Fool's Troupe captain and the Montelli daughter admire each other's resolve.

Brant|Cartethyia.ctx: Brant wonders who Cartethyia really is beyond the Order's tales of saint or sinner.

Brant|Ciaccona.ctx: The bard wonders whether the captain's adventures will make history.

Brant|Galbrena.ctx: Brant's crew helps Galbrena clear the residual Dark Tide.

Brant|Iuno.ctx: Brant and Iuno clean up after the Dark Tide.

Brant|Lupa.ctx: Many Blue Furies gladiators came from the Troupe of Fools; Lupa saw Brant leap off deck to hug his crew.

Brant|Margherita.ctx: Brant buys pizza at Trattoria Margherita.

Brant|Phoebe.ctx: Phoebe sees in Brant the free adventurer from her mother's stories.

Brant|Phrolova.ctx: Phrolova mocks Brant's hope for a "happily ever after".

Brant|Roccia.ctx: Brant leads the Fool's Troupe; Roccia is its First Mate and stage designer.

Brant|Rover.ctx: The Fool's Troupe captain, Rover's ally in Ragunna.

Brant|Zani.ctx: Brant admires Zani for being true to herself; Zani envies his freedom.

Buling|Camellya.ctx: Camellya tried to fight Buling before she joined the Black Shores; Buling passed her test.

Buling|Chisa.ctx: Chisa met the Mengzhou Taoist Buling at the Black Shores and finds her fascinating.

Buling|Chixia.ctx: Buling greets Chixia by name, to her pride.

Buling|Encore.ctx: Buling brings fearless Encore along when chasing ghost rumours.

Buling|Iuno.ctx: Buling and Iuno look for a way through the Dark Tide.

Buling|Jianxin.ctx: Buling and Jianxin trained under the same master and met in a martial contest.

Buling|Namipon.ctx: Namipon guides a worn-out Buling through Honami.

Buling|Qingxiao.ctx: Qingxiao tested Buling rigorously and found her gifted with Thunder Spells.

Buling|Rover.ctx: Buling keeps crossing Rover's path, seeing someone always running between storms.

Buling|Shorekeeper.ctx: Buling sees the Shorekeeper standing outside every law, perhaps too detached.

Buling|Youhu.ctx: Youhu appraises treasures for Buling's clients.

Calcharo|Carlotta.ctx: Carlotta signs a contract with Calcharo's Ghost Hounds.

Calcharo|Encore.ctx: Encore casts Calcharo as a big doggy in her stories.

Calcharo|Galbrena.ctx: They chased the same Tacet Discord in the New Federation: he to kill it, she to absorb it.

Calcharo|Jiyan.ctx: Jiyan took Calcharo's Ghost Hounds on after they crossed into Huanglong; Calcharo respects him.

Calcharo|Mortefi.ctx: Calcharo finds Mortefi a snooty New Federation noble but respects his craft.

Calcharo|Rover.ctx: Calcharo of the Ghost Hounds keeps away from festivals; Rover tries to bring him along.

Calcharo|Verina.ctx: Calcharo gave Verina rare flower seeds when they met in the wild.

Calcharo|Yangyang.ctx: Calcharo stays behind while Yangyang calls Rover to the festival.

Calcharo|Yinlin.ctx: Yinlin once went undercover in Calcharo's group.

Calcharo|Zani.ctx: Zani refers Calcharo for a job, for the referral bonus.

Camellya|Chisa.ctx: Camellya suggested Chisa join the Black Shores and offered her a "germination test".

Camellya|Encore.ctx: Camellya hopes story-loving Encore grows into a strong opponent one day.

Camellya|Jianxin.ctx: Camellya enjoys glimpses of Jianxin's untamed spirit.

Camellya|Jinhsi.ctx: Camellya sees the self-sacrificing Shorekeeper in Jinhsi and doesn't understand it.

Camellya|Lumi.ctx: Camellya and Lumi join the same fight.

Camellya|Rover.ctx: Camellya gave Rover a frequency bracelet before Rinascita and often joins their errands.

Camellya|Shorekeeper.ctx: Carefree Camellya respects the rule-bound Shorekeeper, the Black Shores' de facto leader.

Cantarella|Carlotta.ctx: The heads of Ragunna's Fisalia and Montelli families, who watch each other with interest and coordinate against Leviathan.

Cantarella|Cartethyia.ctx: Cartethyia feels she took Cantarella's future as the Blessed Maiden; Cantarella admires her for reclaiming her humanity.

Cantarella|Changli.ctx: Cantarella and Changli perform together and admire each other's craft.

Cantarella|Ciaccona.ctx: Cantarella and Ciaccona defend Ragunna side by side.

Cantarella|Fenrico.ctx: Cantarella reads the oracle as pointing to Primus Fenrico and his First Relic.

Cantarella|Galbrena.ctx: Galbrena tells Cantarella about Leviathan's state; they defend Ragunna together.

Cantarella|Iuno.ctx: Cantarella's potions support Iuno's plan with the Anchor Stone.

Cantarella|Jué.ctx: Cantarella asks Rover to bring Jué to Rinascita to save Imperator.

Cantarella|Lupa.ctx: Cantarella brews potions to carry the party into the Journey.

Cantarella|Phoebe.ctx: Phoebe fights beside Cantarella and finds her smoke warm and gentle.

Cantarella|Qiuyuan.ctx: Cantarella knows Qiuyuan as one who serves under Lord Liang.

Cantarella|Roccia.ctx: Cantarella finds Roccia, the girl with the giant box, fascinating.

Cantarella|Rover.ctx: The head of the Fisalia family, who credits Rover with the peace after the Maiden's crisis.

Cantarella|Scar.ctx: Cantarella fears the escaped Fractsidus Overseer Scar.

Cantarella|Zani.ctx: Zani sees the Fisalia head as less traditional than people think.

Carlotta|Cartethyia.ctx: Cartethyia values the fresh ideas Carlotta brings to Ragunna; Carlotta investigates her past.

Carlotta|Ciaccona.ctx: Carlotta appraises art fairly and taught Ciaccona about beauty; she sends Ciaccona on errands.

Carlotta|Cristoforo.ctx: Cristoforo warns that Carlotta and Rover will bear the consequences of their quest for the truth.

Carlotta|Fenrico.ctx: Carlotta saw through the thing masquerading as Fenrico after he was slain.

Carlotta|Galbrena.ctx: Carlotta and Galbrena coordinate Ragunna's defence against the Tidespawn.

Carlotta|Iuno.ctx: Iuno admires how Carlotta's family keeps bringing new things to Septimont and Ragunna.

Carlotta|Lupa.ctx: Carlotta and Lupa plan the push into the Dark Tide.

Carlotta|Phoebe.ctx: Carlotta admires Phoebe's kindness but worries it needs strength behind it; she enlists her help with the Order's records.

Carlotta|Phrolova.ctx: Carlotta worries Rover is still under Phrolova's spell.

Carlotta|Qiuyuan.ctx: Carlotta meets Qiuyuan, who saved Sir Leon.

Carlotta|Roccia.ctx: Carlotta hires the Fool's Troupe; Roccia admires how she steers the Montelli family.

Carlotta|Rover.ctx: Rover helped Carlotta expose Capollo's betrayal during Ragunna's Carnevale.

Carlotta|Shorekeeper.ctx: The Shorekeeper asks Carlotta about her taste in scents.

Carlotta|Zani.ctx: Zani works for the Montelli family, which Carlotta represents; together they back Rover.

Cartethyia|Changli.ctx: Changli and Cartethyia clash in temperament during a comedy event.

Cartethyia|Ciaccona.ctx: Cartethyia loved bards' tales as a child; Ciaccona won't sing her unfinished story.

Cartethyia|Cristoforo.ctx: Cristoforo goads Rover about Cartethyia's fate against Leviathan.

Cartethyia|Fenrico.ctx: Fenrico swore none would take Ragunna, Cartethyia included; she saw him redeem himself in the end.

Cartethyia|Galbrena.ctx: Galbrena learned of Cartethyia through the Dark Tide's memory and fought alongside her.

Cartethyia|Iuno.ctx: Iuno doesn't forget Cartethyia's transgression, but works with her.

Cartethyia|Jinhsi.ctx: Jinhsi helps Cartethyia save an anniversary ceremony.

Cartethyia|Jué.ctx: Cartethyia admires the resolve of Jué's Resonator.

Cartethyia|Lupa.ctx: Cartethyia stayed with Lupa in her worst moments; Lupa never treats her as a monster.

Cartethyia|Phoebe.ctx: Cartethyia admires Phoebe's sincere faith; Phoebe dreams of the Blessed Maiden.

Cartethyia|Phrolova.ctx: Phrolova envies Cartethyia: a creation of Divinity with a fully human will.

Cartethyia|Qiuyuan.ctx: Qiuyuan examines the bullet that ended Cartethyia and senses no malice in it.

Cartethyia|Rover.ctx: Rover helped Cartethyia regain her body after her frequency merged with Fleurdelys.

Cartethyia|Zani.ctx: Cartethyia wonders what Zani finds fun.

Changli|Chixia.ctx: Chixia showed Changli around Jinzhou's local gems when she arrived.

Changli|Fuling.ctx: Changli helps Fuling, who has made peace with her coming death.

Changli|Jianxin.ctx: Different sects, shared outlook: Changli values Jianxin's open mind.

Changli|Jinhsi.ctx: Changli raised and taught Jinhsi like a mother, and serves beside her at Jinzhou City Hall.

Changli|Jiyan.ctx: Changli knew of Jiyan from City Hall's files when she first came to Jinzhou.

Changli|Jué.ctx: Changli's story places her steadfastly beside Sentinel Jué.

Changli|Qingxiao.ctx: Qingxiao's Quietude Art once eased the burning pain of Changli's dangerous flame.

Changli|Qiuyuan.ctx: Qiuyuan rarely met Mingting's high-ups like Changli.

Changli|Rover.ctx: Jinzhou's councillor guides Rover at Mt. Firmament, though her own aims stay hidden.

Changli|Sanhua.ctx: Changli and Jinhsi wish their tireless bodyguard Sanhua would rest.

Changli|Xinyi.ctx: Xinyi, mayor of Hongzhen, knows Changli; Changli warned that the Court of Savantae would trap the Sentinel.

Changli|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang knows Changli as the Magistrate's advisor and former teacher.

Changli|Zani.ctx: Changli and Zani share a comedy event.

Changli|Zhezhi.ctx: Zhezhi and Changli face the night together.

Chisa|Encore.ctx: Chisa once helped Encore with maths at the Haven of Sprouts.

Chisa|Hiyuki.ctx: Both from Ashinohara; Hiyuki avoids Chisa because Mikos are omens of dark times there.

Chisa|Lucilla.ctx: Chisa's family took Academy posts from President Lucilla while she was missing; she relies on Lucilla's reports.

Chisa|Luuk Herssen.ctx: Chisa recovered for a while in Dr. Herssen's infirmary.

Chisa|Lynae.ctx: Lynae thought Chisa was distant; they clicked over her bike.

Chisa|Mornye.ctx: Mornye was a teaching assistant when freshman Chisa vanished in the Void Storm.

Chisa|Namipon.ctx: Namipon, Honami's mascot and self-declared guardian, is a calm presence for Chisa.

Chisa|Rover.ctx: Chisa led Rover into Honami City's ruins; afterwards she stayed in the Black Shores' care.

Chisa|Shorekeeper.ctx: The Shorekeeper cared for Chisa while she recovered at the Black Shores; Chisa taught her a drink.

Chisa|Valentina.ctx: Valentina gave Chisa access to the Black Shores database during her recovery.

Chixia|Danjin.ctx: Danjin brings lost children to Chixia, whom no child fears.

Chixia|Encore.ctx: Encore counts Chixia among her besties; Chixia met her while helping Rover.

Chixia|Jianxin.ctx: Chixia always invites Jianxin to spar; Jianxin admires her.

Chixia|Jinhsi.ctx: Jinhsi sent Chixia and Yangyang to investigate the disappearances at Xuanfang.

Chixia|Jiyan.ctx: Jiyan has heard of Chixia's devotion; Chixia trusts him to protect Jinzhou.

Chixia|Jué.ctx: Chixia trusts Jué to choose Jinzhou's Magistrates well.

Chixia|Lingyang.ctx: Lingyang calls Chixia his top rival in helping people.

Chixia|Lumi.ctx: Lumi delivers Chixia's snacks and hero-play merch.

Chixia|Mortefi.ctx: Chixia brings children to Mortefi's lab, and he likes her for it.

Chixia|Rover.ctx: Chixia, a junior Patroller, was among Rover's first companions in Jinzhou.

Chixia|Scar.ctx: Chixia hears from Rover how dangerous Scar is.

Chixia|Taoqi.ctx: Chixia points Rover to Director Taoqi at the city gate.

Chixia|Verina.ctx: Jinzhou friends; Chixia once fed Verina a far too spicy spoonful.

Chixia|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Xiangli Yao credits Baizhi with stabilising Chixia after her injuries.

Chixia|Yangyang.ctx: Jinzhou's Patroller and Outrider, who admire each other and were among the first to meet Rover.

Chixia|Yinlin.ctx: Yinlin is Chixia's senior at the Bureau and her first idol.

Chixia|Youhu.ctx: Youhu steers clear of Patroller Chixia, just in case.

Chixia|Yuanwu.ctx: Chixia is already patrolling outside Yuanwu's gym every morning.

Chixia|Zhezhi.ctx: Chixia invited shy Zhezhi to dinner, which turned out to be a huge gathering.

Ciaccona|Cristoforo.ctx: Ciaccona exposes how someone used the Golden Anthem to stir the public; Cristoforo tests her.

Ciaccona|Fenrico.ctx: Ciaccona reads Fenrico's will in his lantern and suspects they were pawns.

Ciaccona|Fulmine.ctx: Ciaccona and Fulmine offer their Fortes to rebuild Ragunna.

Ciaccona|Iuno.ctx: Iuno asks Ciaccona to come back soon, "for everyone else's sake".

Ciaccona|Margherita.ctx: Ciaccona asks Margherita for help with rumours in Ragunna.

Ciaccona|Phoebe.ctx: Ciaccona keeps the Order's truths from Phoebe after seeing her devotion.

Ciaccona|Qiuyuan.ctx: Ciaccona meets Qiuyuan, newly arrived from Huanglong, in Rinascita.

Ciaccona|Roccia.ctx: Roccia and Ciaccona help rebuild Ragunna.

Ciaccona|Rover.ctx: The bard Ciaccona guides Rover through Ragunna's melodies.

Ciaccona|Zani.ctx: Zani has heard Ciaccona sing Rinascita's old folklore and asked her about the age of heroes.

Cosmos|Encore.ctx: Cosmos is one of Encore's sentient dolls, a gift from her mother.

Cosmos|Roccia.ctx: Cosmos wants Roccia and Pero to play with the Wooly Adventure Squad.

Cristoforo|Denia.ctx: Cristoforo reports that the Spacetrek Collective took Denia in, as the Grand Architect wished.

Cristoforo|Fenrico.ctx: Cristoforo plays on Primus Fenrico's role as the "Enlightened One" in his schemes.

Cristoforo|Galbrena.ctx: Galbrena saw through Cristoforo's script and the decoy he planted.

Cristoforo|Lupa.ctx: Cristoforo frames Lupa's fate in his "weaving time beneath the tide".

Cristoforo|Luuk Herssen.ctx: Luuk knows Cristoforo's Fractsidus codename, Arachnos.

Cristoforo|Phrolova.ctx: Fellow Overseers with clashing tastes; Phrolova mocks his obsession with heroic tales.

Cristoforo|Rover.ctx: Cristoforo, a Fractsidus Overseer posing as a playwright, stopped Rover at the Pilgrim's Sail and toys with them through illusions.

Cristoforo|Scar.ctx: Cristoforo broke Scar out of Jinzhou's prison under Mingting's nose.

Cristoforo|Zani.ctx: Zani met Cristoforo as a "playwright" sharing stories about the Blessed Maiden.

Danjin|Mortefi.ctx: Mortefi repaired Danjin's worn blade; she repaid him the following week.

Danjin|Rover.ctx: Danjin admires Rover's instinct to act against injustice, even without memories.

Danjin|Yangyang.ctx: Danjin admires Yangyang's gentle strength; Yangyang respects Danjin's sense of justice.

Danjin|Yinlin.ctx: Danjin finds Yinlin's thunder reassuring after many joint missions.

Danjin|Youhu.ctx: Youhu admires Danjin's jade but feels no joyful frequency in it.

Danjin|Yuanwu.ctx: Yuanwu senses a dangerous burden in Danjin's way of fighting.

Denia|Hiyuki.ctx: Hiyuki fought Denia under the Fractsidus's influence and feels she failed her.

Denia|Lucilla.ctx: Lucilla blames herself for not seeing what Denia hid; Denia went missing among the Fractsidus.

Denia|Luuk Herssen.ctx: Both have Fractsidus ties in their profiles; Luuk hints that the truth comes to light.

Denia|Lynae.ctx: Startorch schoolmates; Lynae points Rover to Denia.

Denia|Mornye.ctx: Denia thinks Mornye is the perfect teacher; Mornye watches her doze off in lectures.

Denia|Phrolova.ctx: Phrolova was one of the few Overseers who talked to Denia, and played the violin for her.

Denia|Rover.ctx: Rover works to free Denia from the Threnodian frequency the Fractsidus used on her.

Denia|Sigrika.ctx: Friends since a group assignment; Denia worries about the weight Sigrika carries.

Encore|Jiyan.ctx: Jiyan has met Encore once and thinks she and Aalto complement each other.

Encore|Uncle Li.ctx: Uncle Li tells Encore the story of the Plumpcake.

Encore|Valentina.ctx: Valentina relays Tethys warnings built on data from Encore and Aalto.

Encore|Verina.ctx: Verina answers curious Encore's endless questions; Encore loves Verina's flowers.

Encore|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang scolds little Encore for going somewhere dangerous alone.

Encore|Yinlin.ctx: Encore and Yinlin face the "Big Bad Demon" together.

Encore|Zhezhi.ctx: Encore drags camera-shy Zhezhi into photos.

Fenrico|Lenore.ctx: Lenore serves under Primus Fenrico, who banned rumours about the Sentinel.

Fenrico|Phrolova.ctx: Phrolova seeks the Gem that Fenrico holds.

Fenrico|Qiuyuan.ctx: Qiuyuan carried the lantern that awakened Fenrico and saw his end.

Fuling|Rover.ctx: Rover helps Fuling and Wuli in the Immortal Blaze story.

Fuling|Wuli.ctx: Wuli promises to take Fuling to see more new places together.

Fulmine|Phoebe.ctx: Fulmine films the Carnevale and runs into Phoebe.

Fulmine|Zani.ctx: Zani thanks Fulmine for his footage during the Ragunna investigation.

Galbrena|Lupa.ctx: Lupa gave Galbrena candy, which she fed to Chimera.

Galbrena|Margherita.ctx: Margherita gives Galbrena double scoops on the house.

Galbrena|Phoebe.ctx: Phoebe keeps track of where Galbrena went.

Galbrena|Qiuyuan.ctx: Galbrena and Qiuyuan both hunt Cristoforo, who escaped them.

Galbrena|Scar.ctx: Galbrena stands against Scar during the Dark Tide.

Galbrena|Zani.ctx: Zani and Galbrena compare notes after escaping the rift.

Hiyuki|Luuk Herssen.ctx: Luuk sees Hiyuki off and asks her to keep in touch.

Hiyuki|Lynae.ctx: Hiyuki knows some of Lynae's secrets; both are bound by their pasts.

Hiyuki|Rover.ctx: Rover fights alongside Hiyuki through the Starlights crisis in Lahai-Roi.

Hiyuki|Sigrika.ctx: Hiyuki sees Sigrika straining under a Solsworn's expectations far beyond her years.

Hsin|Liangyu.ctx: Liangyu explains Mengzhou's mechanists and Hsin's Hold.

Hsin|Mortefi.ctx: Mortefi traces the technology behind Hsin's Autopuppets.

Hsin|Suisui.ctx: Suisui struck a secret deal with Hsin, who admires her purpose in commerce.

Hsin|Suoming.ctx: Suoming carried Mengzhou while Hsin was absent, resented it, and now serves the Sentinel.

Hsin|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Xiangli Yao calls Xuanfang Hold the Moon Fox's masterpiece.

Hsin|Xuanqing.ctx: Xuanqing was Hsin the Moon Fox's Sentinel Resonator, alive in the Moon Fox's memories.

Hsin|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang investigates who Hsin chose to build Xuanfang Hold.

Iuno|Lupa.ctx: Lupa likes Iuno's unconventional ways; Iuno admires Lupa's pure love of competition.

Iuno|Qiuyuan.ctx: Qiuyuan and Iuno deal with the aftermath of the Dark Tide.

Iuno|Rover.ctx: Rover follows Iuno's memories in Septimont, even after the world forgets she existed.

Iuno|Scar.ctx: Scar taunts Septimont's gladiators while Iuno tracks his frequency.

Jianxin|Jiyan.ctx: Jianxin holds the base while General Jiyan leads the push against the Threnodian.

Jianxin|Lingyang.ctx: Lingyang's liondance grew out of the same martial traditions Jianxin practises.

Jianxin|Lumi.ctx: Lumi once woke to find Jianxin napping on a clifftop boulder.

Jianxin|Rover.ctx: Jianxin helps Rover decode the Magistrate's riddle in Jinzhou.

Jianxin|Sanhua.ctx: Sanhua sees a golden hue in Jianxin's soul.

Jianxin|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang knows Master Jianxin and runs into her on the road.

Jianxin|Youhu.ctx: Youhu knows the secret of Jianxin's mirror.

Jianxin|Zhezhi.ctx: Zhezhi met Jianxin training in the mountains, full of travel tales.

Jingran|Qingxiao.ctx: Years ago Qingxiao gave Jingran's master a divination; Jingran later fights beside her.

Jingran|Qiuyuan.ctx: Qiuyuan let Jingran decide his own revenge.

Jingran|Rover.ctx: Rover and Jingran fight together in Mengzhou; Rover keeps his Qingfu pendant.

Jingran|Suisui.ctx: Each knows the other by reputation: the Chongming Pruner and the Cat of the Nether Lamp.

Jinhsi|Jiyan.ctx: Jinhsi trusts Jiyan to defend Jinzhou's frontier; he respects the different battle she fights.

Jinhsi|Phoebe.ctx: Jinhsi and Phoebe tidy up after a ceremony.

Jinhsi|Qingxiao.ctx: Qingxiao notes Jinhsi has mastered Sword Flight.

Jinhsi|Qiuyuan.ctx: Qiuyuan recognises Rover from the description given by Jinhsi's bodyguard.

Jinhsi|Rover.ctx: The Magistrate of Jinzhou, who trusts Rover and fights beside them for the city.

Jinhsi|Sanhua.ctx: Sanhua is Jinhsi's loyal bodyguard who makes sure she eats and wakes on time.

Jinhsi|Scar.ctx: Jinhsi planned and carried out Scar's capture in Jinzhou.

Jinhsi|Sigrika.ctx: Sigrika would like to meet Jinhsi, who handles her pressure well.

Jinhsi|Uncle Li.ctx: Jinhsi stops by to taste-test Uncle Li's pastries.

Jinhsi|Xinyi.ctx: Jinhsi relies on Xinyi, mayor of Hongzhen, during the Sentinel crisis on Mt. Firmament.

Jinhsi|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang sympathises with Jinhsi, chosen as Magistrate while still a teenager.

Jiyan|Lingyang.ctx: Lingyang's troupe performs before Jiyan's soldiers go into battle.

Jiyan|Sanhua.ctx: Sanhua explains the Midnight Rangers under General Jiyan.

Jiyan|Taoqi.ctx: Taoqi keeps Jinzhou's defences in order so General Jiyan can focus on the front.

Jiyan|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Jiyan shares battle knowledge with Xiangli Yao's research; Xiangli Yao admires him.

Jué|Qingxiao.ctx: Qingxiao knows Rover resolved Mt. Firmament's crisis alongside Jué.

Jué|Sanhua.ctx: Sanhua explains Jinhsi's title of Loong Maiden and Jué's disappearance.

Jué|Scar.ctx: Scar hints there is more to Jué's disappearance than the Fractsidus.

Jué|Xinyi.ctx: Xinyi keeps watch over Jué's Mt. Firmament and counsels Jinhsi on virtue.

Jué|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang introduces Jinzhou's Sentinel Jué to Rover, and saw it manifest in battle.

Lenore|Maji.ctx: Lenore, an Acolyte, offers to take on Maji's dirty jobs.

Lenore|Phoebe.ctx: Lenore notes Phoebe's rise to the Privy Council.

Lenore|Rover.ctx: Rover sees Lenore, former dean of the Minor Forbidden Archive, through the Morning Star quests.

Liangyu|Qingxiao.ctx: Liangyu of the Xuan Triad reports to Paragon Qingxiao.

Liangyu|Suisui.ctx: Liangyu and Suisui weigh Muyu's motives against the Sentinel.

Liangyu|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang travelled with Liangyu of the Xuan Triad during an evacuation; Liangyu refuses her apology.

Lingyang|Mortefi.ctx: Lingyang knows Mortefi as the genius behind Jinzhou's children's toys.

Lingyang|Sanhua.ctx: Sanhua once mistook Lingyang for a wild beast by the shape of his soul.

Lingyang|Taoqi.ctx: Lingyang can't believe Taoqi sleeps through the Qixing Drum.

Lingyang|Verina.ctx: Verina and the Liondance Troupe join Jinzhou's defence.

Lingyang|Yangyang.ctx: Lingyang keeps asking Yangyang to sing at his theatre; she's too shy.

Lingyang|Youhu.ctx: Youhu rates Lingyang's Lucky Greetings almost as cool as her poems.

Lingyang|Yuanwu.ctx: Lingyang brings fish to the cats at Yuanwu's gym.

Lingyang|Zhezhi.ctx: Zhezhi tried to sketch Lingyang's liondance and couldn't keep up.

Lucilla|Lucy.ctx: Lucy knows Lucilla's reputation from the Somnoire crisis and passes on her parting gift.

Lucilla|Luuk Herssen.ctx: The Academy's President and its doctor, who trust each other's skills if not each other's secrets.

Lucilla|Lynae.ctx: Lynae is on a "watchlist" and tries not to break President Lucilla's rules.

Lucilla|Mornye.ctx: The President and the professor who coordinate Startorch's response to the Void anomalies.

Lucilla|Rover.ctx: Rover enrols at Startorch Academy under President Lucilla and works with her through the Synchronist crisis.

Lucilla|Sigrika.ctx: Lucilla is fond of earnest Sigrika, who loves her classes.

Lucy|Luuk Herssen.ctx: Dr. Luuk registers Lucy as a student so she can move freely.

Lucy|Lynae.ctx: When Lucy's ability awakened she hacked Lynae by accident and saw the memories Lynae had locked away.

Lucy|Mornye.ctx: Lucy is moved by Mornye's records and waits on her leads.

Lucy|Rebecca.ctx: Night City crewmates; Rebecca saw Lucy as part of the crew, Lucy never quite opened up.

Lucy|Rover.ctx: Rover and Lucy trace the Nightmare Tacet Discord linked to her in the Somnoire.

Lucy|Sigrika.ctx: Lucy is intrigued by the logic of Sigrika's runes.

Lumi|Rover.ctx: Rover rescues Lumi, the Lollo Logistics navigator, from Tacet Discords.

Lumi|Zhezhi.ctx: Lumi leaves paints and paper at night-owl Zhezhi's door.

Luuk Herssen|Lynae.ctx: Lynae felt Dr. Herssen could see right through her; she suggests his candy flavours.

Luuk Herssen|Phrolova.ctx: Luuk knows Phrolova's Fractsidus codename, Hecate.

Luuk Herssen|Rebecca.ctx: Rebecca warmed to Dr. Luuk, who patches people up, minds included.

Luuk Herssen|Rover.ctx: The Startorch doctor who helps Rover at the Academy; his profile also ties him to the Fractsidus.

Luuk Herssen|Shorekeeper.ctx: The Shorekeeper confirms Luuk Herssen has supplied intelligence to the Black Shores.

Luuk Herssen|Sigrika.ctx: Dr. Luuk looks after overburdened Sigrika, who samples his candies; students owe him after the Celebration.

Lynae|Mornye.ctx: Student and professor who both hate sitting through class; Lynae once took Mornye for a drive.

Lynae|Rebecca.ctx: Graffiti, motorbikes and racing: Rebecca and Lynae click instantly.

Lynae|Rover.ctx: Rover first suspected Lynae in the Frostlands Detector incident before they became allies at the Academy.

Lynae|Sigrika.ctx: Same year at Startorch; Sigrika helped Lynae settle in and pass Royan Cultural History.

Maji|Rover.ctx: Maji, of Lollo Logistics, taught Rover to transmit data on their jobs.

Maji|Zani.ctx: Maji thanks Zani for the pizza delivered to the Vault staff.

Margherita|Roccia.ctx: The smell of Margherita's brings back Roccia's childhood; the Troupe performs there.

Margherita|Rover.ctx: Rover orders gelato and pizza at Margherita's.

Margherita|Zani.ctx: Trattoria Margherita is Zani's go-to restaurant.

Mornye|Rebecca.ctx: Mornye studies Rebecca's weapons; Rebecca is amazed by Mornye's transparent prosthetic legs.

Mornye|Rover.ctx: Professor Mornye guides Rover at Startorch through the Frostlands and Second Sunrise crises.

Mornye|Sigrika.ctx: Mornye finds Sigrika conscientious to a fault; Sigrika helps her at the Reactor Drive.

Mornye|Valentina.ctx: Valentina receives Professor Mornye's guest at the Black Shores.

Mortefi|Rover.ctx: Mortefi keeps Rover updated on Autopuppet data after the Jinzhou aftermath.

Mortefi|Taoqi.ctx: Taoqi coordinates Mortefi's team during the emergency.

Mortefi|Verina.ctx: Verina worries Mortefi doesn't sleep enough.

Mortefi|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Mortefi swears to out-invent Xiangli Yao, who admires his drive.

Mortefi|Yangyang.ctx: Mortefi finds Yangyang's humming calming; Yangyang introduced him to Rover.

Mortefi|Youhu.ctx: Youhu hopes the cultured Mortefi becomes her client.

Namipon|Platya.ctx: Namipon and Platya, both of Honami, meet again.

Namipon|Rover.ctx: Namipon guides Rover and Chisa through Honami and asks them to come back.

Namipon|Shorekeeper.ctx: Namipon helped the Black Shores stabilise a tunnel between Lahai-Roi and Honami City.

Phoebe|Roccia.ctx: Phoebe was the first Acolyte to touch Roccia's box without Pero biting.

Phoebe|Rover.ctx: Phoebe, an Acolyte of the Order of the Deep, helps Rover across Ragunna.

Phoebe|Zani.ctx: A devout Acolyte and a sceptical Montelli employee who respect each other.

Phrolova|Rover.ctx: Phrolova, a Fractsidus Overseer, works against Rover and claims Lupa will bring the Dark Tide to Septimont.

Phrolova|Scar.ctx: Fellow Overseers; Phrolova finds Scar's rule-breaking inelegant.

Platya|Rover.ctx: Platya and Rover track the Ghost Miko together in Ashinohara.

Platya|Valentina.ctx: Platya asks Valentina for field leave to return to Honami, her hometown.

Qingxiao|Rover.ctx: Rover calls Qingxiao their partner and protects her through Song of the Heart Sword.

Qingxiao|Suisui.ctx: Qingxiao once cleared Tacet Discords from Suisui's caravan's path through Xuanfang.

Qingxiao|Suoming.ctx: Suoming turns to Paragon Qingxiao, who knows Hsin the Moon Fox well.

Qingxiao|Yangyang.ctx: Qingxiao sees the Xuanling Bird in Yangyang and relies on her in Mengzhou.

Qiuyuan|Rover.ctx: Qiuyuan, sent from Mingting to Rinascita, was told to help Rover there.

Qiuyuan|Sanhua.ctx: Sanhua descends from a branch of Qiuyuan's family that left Chongzhou for the borderlands; both live for the sword.

Qiuyuan|Scar.ctx: Qiuyuan was ordered to execute Scar, the escaped Fractsidus Overseer, in Rinascita.

Qiuyuan|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Qiuyuan and Xiangli Yao plan together during an event.

Qiuyuan|Zhezhi.ctx: Qiuyuan and Zhezhi plan together during an event.

Rebecca|Rover.ctx: Rebecca, from Night City, works with Rover in the Somnoire.

Rebecca|Sigrika.ctx: Rebecca thinks Sigrika is too responsible and helped her win at games.

Roccia|Rover.ctx: Roccia helps Rover track Abby's frequency in Ragunna.

Roccia|Zani.ctx: Roccia finds Zani the definition of a reliable adult to work with.

Rover|Sanhua.ctx: Sanhua, Jinhsi's guard, greets Rover as an old acquaintance.

Rover|Scar.ctx: Scar, a Fractsidus Overseer, saw in Rover a vessel for the Crownless and hunted them from Jinzhou on.

Rover|Shorekeeper.ctx: The Shorekeeper watches over Rover, who turns to her for the Black Shores' help.

Rover|Sigrika.ctx: Rover and Sigrika solved the Divinator's riddles together, through the Celebration and into the Dark Side.

Rover|Suisui.ctx: Suisui, Yangyang's sister, writes to Rover and seeks them out during the Mengzhou crisis.

Rover|Suoming.ctx: Rover digs into Intendant Suoming's role in the Sentinel's "assassination" in Mengzhou.

Rover|Valentina.ctx: Valentina, Black Shores commander, points Rover to Chisa's guide.

Rover|Verina.ctx: Verina helped Rover back in Jinzhou.

Rover|Wuli.ctx: Rover looks for Wuli and Fuling in Rinascita.

Rover|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Rover explores Xiangli Yao's past and his Autopuppets during Wish Upon the Moon.

Rover|Xinyi.ctx: Xinyi points Rover to the Truthseeker's Pass and handles the aftermath with Changli.

Rover|Xuanqing.ctx: A memory of Xuanqing, Hsin's Sentinel Resonator, journeyed with Rover to restore Hsin's Feeling Capsule.

Rover|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang was among the first to find Rover on waking and showed them the way to Jinzhou.

Rover|Yinlin.ctx: Yinlin, an undercover Patroller, sees investigative potential in Rover.

Rover|Yuanwu.ctx: Yuanwu senses Rover has lived through far more than he has.

Rover|Zani.ctx: Zani welcomed Rover to Ragunna on the Montelli family's behalf.

Rover|Zhezhi.ctx: Rover reassures Zhezhi, the painter, through the Mengzhou crisis and her own quests.

Sanhua|Scar.ctx: Sanhua helped capture Scar, who claimed the Fractsidus had imprisoned the Sentinel.

Sanhua|Suisui.ctx: Suisui apologises to Sanhua for doubting her on arriving in Jinzhou.

Sanhua|Taoqi.ctx: Taoqi wishes she had a helper like Sanhua.

Sanhua|Uncle Li.ctx: Uncle Li counts on Sanhua and Rover for his Plumpcake seeds.

Sanhua|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Sanhua briefed Xiangli Yao on Rover's situation.

Sanhua|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang recounts how one cold look from Sanhua turns intruders away.

Scar|Yangyang.ctx: Scar captured Yangyang to win Rover's trust and planted fake clues.

Shorekeeper|Valentina.ctx: Valentina relays the Shorekeeper's worries and whereabouts.

Suisui|Yangyang.ctx: Suisui is Yangyang's older sister; alike in face, opposite in spirit.

Suoming|Yinlin.ctx: Yinlin meets Lady Suoming at Xuanfang.

Taoqi|Xiangli Yao.ctx: Taoqi consults Xiangli Yao on projects that overlap with the Academy.

Taoqi|Yangyang.ctx: Taoqi sends Yangyang with Rover; Yangyang admires her calm under pressure.

Uncle Li|Yinlin.ctx: Yinlin investigates the Tacet Discords drawn to Uncle Li's purchases.

Uncle Li|Zhezhi.ctx: Zhezhi compares every dish to Uncle Li's.

Verina|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang listens patiently to Verina explain her plants.

Verina|Zhezhi.ctx: Zhezhi and Verina spend hours on plants: their habits, and their meaning in Huanglong.

Xiangli Yao|Yangyang.ctx: Yangyang knows Xiangli Yao by sight through Mortefi.

Yangyang|Yinlin.ctx: Yangyang told Yinlin what Rover went through after Rinascita.

Yangyang|Youhu.ctx: Yangyang introduces Youhu, the antique appraiser, who teases her about Rover.

Yangyang|Zhezhi.ctx: Zhezhi tracks Yangyang's case and is among those who call her.

Yinlin|Zhezhi.ctx: Yinlin and Zhezhi fight the night's threat together.

Youhu|Zhezhi.ctx: Youhu pointed Zhezhi to collectors of rare old paintings.
